definitions: A software application or utility designed to assist developers in various stages of the software development lifecycle, often incorporating contemporary features like AI assistance, cloud integration, or real-time collaboration.
Any advanced technological resource or platform that enhances the efficiency, quality, or speed of software creation and maintenance.
examples: This modern developer tool streamlines our CI/CD pipeline.
Adopting a new modern developer tool significantly improved team productivity.
The company invested heavily in a suite of modern developer tools.
